fusions.name: Long Migration
fusions.desc: Sends a flight of locusts at a target up to 8 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Thermal Stoop
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then the swarm lands with you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and healing you for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Scatter and Regather
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a spot up to 7 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fed in Passing
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
